name: @cdp/web-client
description: Typed client for cdp's web API (web/api/app.py), generated from its OpenAPI schema.

scripts.generate: cd ../.. && python -c "import json; from web.api.app import app; json.dump(app.openapi(), open('web/openapi.json', 'w'), indent=2)" && openapi-typescript web/openapi.json -o web/client/schema.ts
